name: iranti
description: Persistent shared memory for AI coding agents. Stores facts as entity/key/value triples with hybrid semantic search, task checkpoints, and conflict resolution — shared across Claude Code, Codex CLI, and GitHub Copilot.

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: PostgreSQL connection string for your Iranti instance (postgresql://user:pass@host/dbname)

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: Iranti API key — generate one with: npx iranti api-key:create

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: URL of your running Iranti instance (e.g. http://localhost:3001)
